description:
# Test Cases for REF-10: Add Product to Shopping Cart

## Positive Test Cases

**Test ID**: TC-001  
**Test Title**: Add in-stock product to cart with default quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and quantity = 1  
2. Cart icon updates to show item count  
3. Success message is displayed  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: Critical  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-002  
**Test Title**: Add product with specific quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Set quantity to 3 using quantity selector  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and quantity = 3  
2. Cart subtotal reflects price × 3  
3. Cart icon updates to show item count  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-003  
**Test Title**: Add product to cart as guest user  
**Preconditions**: User is not logged in and is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
2. Close browser  
3. Reopen website  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and quantity  
2. Cart persists after browser is closed and reopened (via cookies/local storage)  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-004  
**Test Title**: Add product to cart as logged-in user  
**Preconditions**: User is logged in and is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
2. Log out  
3. Log back in  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and quantity  
2. Cart persists across logout/login sessions  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-005  
**Test Title**: Add multiple different products to cart  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of first in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
2. Navigate to a different product page  
3. Click "Add to Cart" button for second product  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Both items appear in cart with correct prices and quantities  
2. Cart subtotal reflects sum of all items  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-006  
**Test Title**: Add same product multiple times  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button again  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart once with quantity = 2  
2. Cart subtotal reflects price × 2  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-007  
**Test Title**: Add product to cart from quick view  
**Preconditions**: User is on category page with quick view feature available  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Quick View" on a product  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button in quick view modal  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and quantity  
2. Quick view modal closes or shows confirmation  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Positive  

**Test ID**: TC-008  
**Test Title**: Add product with maximum allowed quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Set quantity to maximum allowed value  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Item appears in cart with correct price and maximum quantity  
2. Cart subtotal reflects price × maximum quantity  
**Test Type**: Boundary  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Positive  

## Negative Test Cases

**Test ID**: TC-009  
**Test Title**: Add out-of-stock product to cart  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an out-of-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. "Out of stock" message is displayed  
2. Product is not added to cart  
**Test Type**: Functional  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-010  
**Test Title**: Add product with quantity exceeding stock  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an item with limited stock (e.g., 5 units)  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Set quantity to a value exceeding available stock (e.g., 10)  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Error message indicates maximum available quantity  
2. Either no product is added or only available quantity is added  
**Test Type**: Boundary  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-011  
**Test Title**: Add product with zero quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Set quantity to 0 (if UI allows)  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Error message indicates invalid quantity  
2. Product is not added to cart  
**Test Type**: Boundary  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-012  
**Test Title**: Add product with negative quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Attempt to set quantity to -1 (if UI allows)  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. UI prevents setting negative value or shows error message  
2. Product is not added to cart  
**Test Type**: Boundary  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-013  
**Test Title**: Add product with non-numeric quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item with manual quantity input  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Enter non-numeric value (e.g., "abc") in quantity field  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Error message indicates invalid quantity  
2. Product is not added to cart  
**Test Type**: Input Validation  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-014  
**Test Title**: Add product with extremely large quantity  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Set quantity to extremely large number (e.g., 999999)  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. System handles large input appropriately (error message or maximum limit applied)  
2. System performance remains stable  
**Test Type**: Performance/Boundary  
**Priority**: Low  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-015  
**Test Title**: Add product during price update  
**Preconditions**:  
1. User is on product page of an in-stock item  
2. Backend price update is scheduled/simulated  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button at the exact moment price is being updated in backend  
**Expected Results**:  
1. System handles race condition gracefully  
2. User is charged the price shown at time of adding to cart  
3. No system errors occur  
**Test Type**: Concurrency  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-016  
**Test Title**: Add product with network interruption  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Click "Add to Cart" button  
2. Immediately interrupt network connection  
**Expected Results**:  
1. System shows appropriate error message  
2. Upon network restoration, system recovers (either completes action or notifies user to retry)  
**Test Type**: Error Handling  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-017  
**Test Title**: Add product with session timeout  
**Preconditions**:  
1. User is logged in and session is about to expire  
2. User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Wait for session to timeout  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
**Expected Results**:  
1. System either extends session or prompts for re-login  
2. After re-authentication, product is added to cart successfully  
**Test Type**: Session Management  
**Priority**: Medium  
**Classification**: Negative  

**Test ID**: TC-018  
**Test Title**: Verify price sync with backend  
**Preconditions**: User is on product page of an in-stock item  
**Test Steps**:  
1. Note the displayed price  
2. Click "Add to Cart" button  
3. View cart details  
**Expected Results**:  
1. Price in cart matches price displayed on product page  
2. Price matches backend price in database  
**Test Type**: Data Integrity  
**Priority**: High  
**Classification**: Positive
